cards.back:
A place where children learn.
Bahasa Indonesia: sekolah
Example: I go to school by bus.
cards.say: school. A place where children learn. I go to school by bus.

cards.back:
A person who helps you learn.
Bahasa Indonesia: guru
Example: My teacher is kind.
cards.say: teacher. A person who helps you learn. My teacher is kind.

cards.back:
A person who learns at school.
Bahasa Indonesia: murid
Example: The student reads a book.
cards.say: student. A person who learns at school. The student reads a book.

cards.back:
The room where you learn.
Bahasa Indonesia: ruang kelas
Example: Our classroom is clean.
cards.say: classroom. The room where you learn. Our classroom is clean.

cards.back:
A table where you write at school.
Bahasa Indonesia: meja
Example: My book is on the desk.
cards.say: desk. A table where you write at school. My book is on the desk.

cards.back:
Pages with words and pictures to read.
Bahasa Indonesia: buku
Example: I read a funny book.
cards.say: book. Pages with words and pictures to read. I read a funny book.

cards.back:
You write with it, and you can rub it out.
Bahasa Indonesia: pensil
Example: I have a yellow pencil.
cards.say: pencil. You write with it, and you can rub it out. I have a yellow pencil.

cards.back:
You write with ink.
Bahasa Indonesia: pulpen
Example: She writes with a pen.
cards.say: pen. You write with ink. She writes with a pen.

cards.back:
You use it to rub out pencil marks.
Bahasa Indonesia: penghapus
Example: I use a rubber to fix it.
cards.say: rubber. You use it to rub out pencil marks. I use a rubber to fix it.

cards.back:
You use it to draw straight lines.
Bahasa Indonesia: penggaris
Example: The ruler is thirty centimetres long.
cards.say: ruler. You use it to draw straight lines. The ruler is thirty centimetres long.

cards.back:
A large flat place for the teacher to write on.
Bahasa Indonesia: papan tulis
Example: The teacher writes on the board.
cards.say: board. A large flat place for the teacher to write on. The teacher writes on the board.

cards.back:
Thin sheets you write or draw on.
Bahasa Indonesia: kertas
Example: I draw on white paper.
cards.say: paper. Thin sheets you write or draw on. I draw on white paper.

cards.back:
A coloured stick for drawing.
Bahasa Indonesia: krayon
Example: I draw with a red crayon.
cards.say: crayon. A coloured stick for drawing. I draw with a red crayon.

cards.back:
You use them to cut paper.
Bahasa Indonesia: gunting
Example: Be careful with the scissors.
cards.say: scissors. You use them to cut paper. Be careful with the scissors.

cards.back:
A sticky thing that joins paper.
Bahasa Indonesia: lem
Example: I use glue on the paper.
cards.say: glue. A sticky thing that joins paper. I use glue on the paper.

cards.back:
A drawing or photo.
Bahasa Indonesia: gambar
Example: I draw a picture of a cat.
cards.say: picture. A drawing or photo. I draw a picture of a cat.

cards.back:
To look at words and understand them.
Bahasa Indonesia: membaca
Example: I read a story.
cards.say: read. To look at words and understand them. I read a story.

cards.back:
To make letters with a pen or pencil.
Bahasa Indonesia: menulis
Example: I write my name.
cards.say: write. To make letters with a pen or pencil. I write my name.

cards.back:
To make a picture with a pencil.
Bahasa Indonesia: menggambar
Example: I draw a big sun.
cards.say: draw. To make a picture with a pencil. I draw a big sun.

cards.back:
A time when you learn.
Bahasa Indonesia: pelajaran
Example: The English lesson is fun.
cards.say: lesson. A time when you learn. The English lesson is fun.
